dedupe_keys.name: mcs data dashboard and mcs installations database certified small scale renewable installations in the uk solar pv heat pumps

description: MCS runs the certification scheme for small-scale renewable installations in the United Kingdom. Its MCS Installations Database holds details of every MCS-certified small-scale renewable energy installation since 2008, and the MCS Data Dashboard, launched in 2022, visualises it with updates every 24 hours. The dashboard has Installation Insights and Scheme Insights sections that filter by month, year, location, technology and installation type, covering technologies such as solar PV and heat pumps, and each visualisation offers image and data exports for download. Scope is up to 50 kWe for electricity-generating and up to 45 kWth for heat-generating technologies (70 kWth for several products in one system), mostly retrofit. Some data are augmented with UK census, ONS and DESNZ statistics. MCS states the data are free and open to the public to view and use, and further data beyond the dashboard can be requested. Coverage is the United Kingdom. Caveats: MCS certification is not mandatory, so not all installations are captured; 2008 installations and records with invalid addresses are left out, the licence is not named, and the dashboard application failed to load for automated reading on the day. Simulation uses are local uptake of rooftop PV and heat pumps for distribution network load growth and electrification scenarios. Related records: data-mopo-heat-sector-timeseries gives heat pump performance series.
